purpose: Casual home register hitting body/object vocabulary (耳/箸/右/知る/だって) naturally.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 正坊、お箸は右手で持つのよ。
lines.en: Sho dear, hold your chopsticks in your right hand.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm gentle patient delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: だって、左の方が持ちやすいよ。
lines.en: But the left is easier to hold!
lines.style: pouty small child voice, bright warm insistent delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お箸の持ち方も、覚えると良いわ。
lines.en: It's good to learn how to hold chopsticks too.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm gentle patient delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Holding with my right feels weird.
lines.style: uncertain small child voice, bright warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 練習すれば、すぐ慣れると知るわよ。
lines.en: If you practice, you'll soon find you get used to it.
lines.style: encouraging grandmother voice, soft warm gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 耳まで、ご飯ついちゃった!
lines.en: I got rice up to my ear!
lines.style: giggly small child voice, bright warm playful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あらあら、耳を拭きましょうね。
lines.en: Oh my, let's wipe your ear.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm amused affectionate delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I held it with my right hand, look!
lines.style: proud small child voice, bright warm triumphant delivery throughout
